name: Marigold normals LCM
plain: Marigold normals LCM from ETH Zurich (PRS): surface normals from one image in one diffusion step on a Stable Diffusion UNet. Apache-2.0 code and weights.
summary: Marigold normals (Ke et al. 2023/2025): surface normals by diffusion; a Stable Diffusion 2 UNet fine-tuned to denoise a normals latent conditioned on the image latent, distilled to one LCM step (v0.1).

papers.title: Marigold: Affordable Adaptation of Diffusion-Based Image Generators for Image Analysis

official.reason: The prs-eth/marigold-normals-lcm-v0-1 weights are published as a diffusers pipeline, so fastforks follows the diffusers implementation rather than the authors' own repository.

limitations: Diffusion model: the seeded noise comes from a CPU generator and differs from a CUDA generator's for the same seed.
A traced or exported module reuses the noise of its traced shape.
task_io: Input: one RGB image. Output: a depth or inverse-depth map. `kind` (a card field, `result.kind`) says what the numbers mean: `metric` = metres; `scale_invariant`, `affine_invariant` and `affine_invariant_inverse` are relative (unknown scale or shift, not metres). Metric models that use the focal length take `model(image, intrinsics=K)` (K `[3, 3]`, pixels of the input): `metric3d-vit-large` and `da3metric-large` need it for correct metres (`da3metric-large`: metres = output x focal / 300; without `intrinsics=` a 300 px focal length is assumed, wrong for a real camera). `unidepth-v2-vitl14`, `unik3d-vitl`, `depth-pro` and MoGe estimate the camera themselves (given `intrinsics=` replace `fx`); `zoedepth-nk` and the relative models (`da3mono-large` too) take none. Normals-only models (`kind` `none`) return `result.normals` `[B, H, W, 3]` (unit vectors, camera frame: x right, y down, z forward).

licence.training_note: Stable Diffusion 2 (LAION-5B subsets) fine-tuned on the synthetic Hypersim, Virtual KITTI 2 and other synthetic datasets per the Marigold paper (arXiv 2505.09358), then LCM-distilled

variants.input_size: any H x W >= 1, resized or padded inside the model

portable.protocol: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

kernels.protocol: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

original16.protocol: median of 5 after 3 warm-up, uint8 CUDA input, original code at the pinned commit, torch.no_grad; peak = max over the first call and the timed calls

quality.protocol: AbsRel / delta1 after a least-squares scale + shift fit (in disparity space for inverse-depth models), mean over images. Normals: angle to the ground-truth normal over the pixels with ground truth (Marigold's evaluation sets), mean over images.
